description: Find companies related to the given company by evidence MIL holds: industry_cluster (same SNI classification) and address_cluster (same registered postal code). Relation types MIL has no source data for, such as board_member and ownership, are reported as unavailable with a reason rather than as an empty result.

relation_type.description: Relation to search for. industry_cluster and address_cluster are supported; board_member and ownership return an explicit unavailable status because MIL does not yet ingest that data.

name: find_related_companies
